tidbit: Did you know… about 4,700 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Grok has released the first seven minutes of its AI-generated Odyssey. Reported by TechCrunch.
Elvis Presley's rights owners are suing Anthropic over the use of 274 songs. Reported by The Needle Drop.
Claude was consuming 84.6K tokens at the start of every chat. Reported by How-To Geek: the desktop app uses 84.6K tokens on Hi while the CLI uses 36.9K with minimal setup.
Anthropic quietly separated Claude Agent SDK usage from subscription limits and introduced a modest credit system for production teams. Reported by Startup Fortune.
Elvis Presley's Estate is taking on Anthropic in a legal battle over the use of 274 tracks to train Claude. Reported by Hit Channel.
Free every hour.
